messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT - high 5xx and tail latency for tenant lumen-data during canary rollout to nebula-dedicated-3. group=nebula-canary-3, artifact=rwd-inference:v2.8.0-q4, start=1930023456, 5xx_rate=27%, p95_latency=1850ms
rachel: i'm awake, pulling telemetry. Lumen support ticket SUP-1142 just came in. They report timeouts and 503.
omar: confirmed. dashboard shows surge of 503 + client timeouts confined to traffic slice for lumen-data. other tenants on same pool mostly ok but a few intermittent 503 spikes.
priya: is this the artifact we pinned earlier for canary? control plane shows nebula-canary-3 running v2.8.0-q4.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout event created id=cr-88321 target=nebula-canary-3 artifact=rwd-inference:v2.8.0-q4
rachel: ok containment plan: steer lumen-data routing back to last-stable artifact rwd-inference:v2.7.3-q4 (manual override) and then revert canary nodes.
infra-operator: i can run the routing override. command:
```
redwoodctl routing override --tenant=lumen-data --artifact=rwd-inference:v2.7.3-q4 --scope=pool:nebula-dedicated-3 --reason="emergency rollback due to 5xx spike"
```
infra-operator: executing now. job=job-99012 started 1930023475
infra-operator: job-99012 succeeded. lumen-data traffic now routed to v2.7.3-q4.
rachel: monitoring... p95 dropping to ~220ms within 45s, 5xx down to 2.3% (baseline ~0.5%). support can confirm.
support: message sent to customer: "We've diverted your traffic to a stable model and are actively investigating. No data exposure detected. We'll follow up with ETA for a fix." (SUP-1142 updated 1930023508)
omar: good. next step: revert the canary artifact in the pool to avoid accidental re-roll. who can kick the rollback job?
priya: i'll create rollout rollback. starting orchestration.
deploy-bot: Rollback job created id=rb-4421 target=nebula-canary-3 artifact=rwd-inference:v2.7.3-q4 initiated_by=priya started=1930023520
deploy-bot: rollback step: cordon and drain canary nodes - 6/6 drained
deploy-bot: rollback step: deploy artifact rwd-inference:v2.7.3-q4 - 6/6 deployed
deploy-bot: rollback step: health checks - 6/6 passing. rollback complete. rb-4421 finished=1930023570
rachel: rollback confirmed. eng-runtime, please triage root cause. preliminary hypothesis: q4 quantization path has a kernel scheduling/tls/kv-cache regression under our dedicated pool memory allocator.
eng-runtime: ack. running reproducer with lumen traffic profile. capturing kernel traces, kv cache high-water marks, and sequence-length distribution. assigned eng-kernel.
eng-kernel: early trace shows progressive kv-cache fragmentation causing eviction thrashing when sequence lengths exceed 1024 and concurrent requests > 20. looks like a regression from allocator patch in v2.8.0.
omar: adding followups: 1) compile kernel allocator metrics + reproducer artifacts to S3 2) ensure no other tenants in nebula-canary-3 degraded 3) block v2.8.0-q4 from scheduled pool rollouts until patch
infra-operator: I've added a temporary gate on artifact v2.8.0-q4: tag=blocked for pool rollouts.
priya: also suggest adding canary health gating on tail-5xx > 1% OR p95 > 1s to auto-fail rollouts.
rachel: agreed. jordan-oncall, i'll hand off for night follow-up. I'm heading offline in 25m.
jordan-oncall: taking over. I'll track ENG triage, ensure SUP-1142 updates, and confirm block stays in place. escalations ping @eng-lead if reproducer artifacts indicate kernel regression.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (post-rollback containment) for nebula-canary-3 at 1930023610 by rachel. severity=P2
rachel: final notes: impact window ~1930023456 - 1930023520, affected tenant lumen-data only on nebula-dedicated-3. no data leakage. owners: eng-runtime, eng-kernel, infra-operator. followups logged in incidents board.
